title: Write the Saga of JMAP from mailing list archive
description: Analyze 2,763 JMAP WG mailing list emails in ./MDIR to write a comprehensive narrative history of JMAP's development. Use parallel subagents to research different eras and themes without blowing context.
close_reason: Both narratives written and pushed: the-saga-of-jmap.md (8,080 words) and the-story-of-jmap-metadata.md (~1,700 words). Built from 2,763 mailing list messages using six parallel research agents.
